climate-security-2021-12-13.all-1: Russia rejected the draft's automatic climate-security link, preferring substantive climate work at the UNFCCC and a separate alternative addressing the Sahel. India sought to preserve the climate forum's distinct identity while supporting a narrower alternative focused on specific regional issues. Russia and India both emphasized the need for the UNFCCC to lead climate action and advocated for a dedicated Sahel alternative.
climate-security-2021-12-13.all-2: India sought to preserve the universal, consensus-based UNFCCC forum and supported a narrower alternative limited to the Sahel. Russia objected to an automatic climate-security link and preferred a treatment of the Sahel that excluded broader regional expansion. Both delegations shared a commitment to the UNFCCC and supported a Sahel-specific alternative.
